newsitem.title: GERMANY: E.German aluminium works placed into receivership.
newsitem.headline: E.German aluminium works placed into receivership.

text.p: Eastern German aluminium re-roller Rackwitz Aluminium AG filed for bankruptcy proceedings because it could no longer meet its financial obligations, local law courts said on Tuesday.
A producer of continuously-cast sections and foils, the company last year produced 1,800 tonnes per month of processed metal.
The company said last month it had run up unexpected losses because of start-up problems with new machinery and because of an aluminium demand lull.
The company said in a statement Tuesday it had unsuccessfully tried to establish a consortium of banks to step in and offer finance to continue operations.
The Saxony state economics ministry said it would aim to help and save the plant and some 350 jobs by supporting the efforts of the official receiver, said lawyer Winfrid Andres.

The formerly state-owned plant was sold by privatisation agency Treuhand on January 1, 1994 to the West German Gottschol group, which operates seven other aluminium plants specialising in aluminium billets and casting alloys.
